LEGAL & TRANSPARENCY

Privacy Policy for HeyMom

We take your privacy and sensitive health data seriously. This Privacy Policy outlines how your information is handled, secured, and protected across HeyMom and Yorik Labs applications.

Application: HeyMom Developer: Yorik Labs

Effective Date: August 08, 2026

Zero Data Sales Health Encryption

Table of Contents

1. Introduction 2. Information We Collect 3. How We Use Your Information 4. How We Share Your Information 5. Data Security 6. Data Retention & Deletion 7. Children's Privacy 8. Changes to This Privacy Policy 9. Contact Us

Questions about your health data? Email yorik.labs@gmail.com

01. Introduction

Welcome to HeyMom ("we," "our," or "us"), developed by Yorik Labs. We are deeply committed to protecting your privacy, especially regarding the sensitive personal and health information you share with us during your pregnancy journey.

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our mobile application. By using HeyMom, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

02. Information We Collect

To provide you with a personalized, reliable pregnancy tracking experience, we may collect the following types of information:

A. Personal Information

Name, email address, or account credentials when you register or sign into the app.

B. Health and Sensitive Data

Due date, menstrual cycle dates, pregnancy symptoms, weight tracking, medical appointments, ultrasound images, and any other personal health notes you voluntarily input into the app.

🛡️ Health data is encrypted and handled with strict privacy protocols.

C. Device and Usage Data

Information about your mobile device (e.g., device model, operating system version), IP address, and technical interaction logs (e.g., features used, session timestamps) to improve app performance.

03. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect primarily to operate, maintain, and enhance the app. Specifically, we use your data to:

  • Calculate pregnancy milestones and provide tailored daily/weekly fetal developmental updates.
  • Allow you to log, monitor, and visualize personal health metrics, symptoms, and appointment reminders.
  • Securely back up your data and restore it across devices (if you create an account).
  • Respond promptly to your customer support requests or feedback.
  • Analyze general usage patterns to improve app stability, speed, and usability.

04. How We Share Your Information

We take the privacy of your health data extremely seriously. We do NOT sell your personal or health data to third parties, advertisers, or data brokers under any circumstances.

We may share your information only in the following limited circumstances:

Service Providers

With trusted third-party infrastructure providers who assist us in operating the app (e.g., secure cloud hosting like Google Cloud or AWS, privacy-focused analytics). These providers are contractually obligated to keep your data confidential and use it strictly for the services they perform for us.

Legal Requirements

If required by law, court order, subpoena, or government regulation, or when necessary to protect the safety, rights, or property of our users, Yorik Labs, or the public.

05. Data Security

We implement industry-standard administrative, technical, and physical security measures to protect your sensitive health data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

This includes end-to-end HTTPS encryption of data in transit (TLS/SSL) and secure storage encryption at rest. While we adhere to strict standards, please note that no transmission method over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure.

06. Data Retention and Deletion

We retain your personal and health data only for as long as your account remains active or as needed to provide you with the app's services.

Your Right to Delete: You can request to delete your account and all associated health records at any time directly through the app settings or by contacting us at yorik.labs@gmail.com. Upon receiving your deletion request, your data will be permanently purged from our active servers.

07. Children's Privacy

HeyMom is designed for expecting parents and is not intended for use by children under the age of 13 (or the applicable legal age in your jurisdiction). We do not knowingly collect or solicit personal information from children. If we learn that we have collected personal data from a child, we will take prompt steps to delete that information.

08. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect app updates, security improvements, or regulatory changes. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the updated Privacy Policy within the app and updating the "Effective Date" at the top of this page.

09. Contact Us

If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or how we handle your personal and health data, please feel free to reach out to us:
